title: Sandbox escape due to race condition in the XPConnect component
description: CVE-2026-92050 is a vulnerability in the XPConnect component of Microsoft software version 4.0, involving a race condition that could allow sandbox escape. The vulnerability is identified as a concurrency issue (CWE-362). No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild. No patch or remediation details are available from the vendor at this time.
